title: Swedish stale-plan pill tooltip renders a literal {minuter} instead of the minute limit
claim: Under hass.language sv, the card's stale-plan status pill title produced by statusPill() reads 'Ingen ny plan på mer än {minuter} min.' with the placeholder unsubstituted, because STRINGS.sv['status.stale_title'] names {minuter} while the call site passes {minutes}.
mechanism: statusPill() calls L('status.stale_title', { minutes: Math.round(age.limit) }); L() substitutes only names present in vars and leaves any other {name} verbatim; the sv translation renamed the token to {minuter}. tests/card.mjs's parity check (R10-I18N-DE) states it refuses a dropped placeholder; that check did not keep this one out of the baseline (lead to the D3 owner).

evidence.contention_note: shared finder box during fan-out; count is load-immune

perturbation.change: in memory: STRINGS.sv['status.stale_title'] with {minuter} replaced by {minutes} (--perturb)

metric_definition: Count of {name} tokens left in statusPill(plan,now).title under setLanguage('sv-SE') for a plan whose last solve is 200 min old (limit 90).
phenomenon_property: Every card translation renders through L() with no literal {name} token left when the call site passes the placeholders the English source names (plus any listed call-site extras).
seam_rule: node dev/audit/rounds/round11/D6/s4/card_placeholders.mjs   (RESULT unresolved_<lang> enumerates every key of every STRINGS dictionary rendered through production L; offender lines name each seam)

null_control.note: the same render over the en source and the de translation leaves no token; only sv/status.stale_title is an offender

proposed_fix_scope: Rename {minuter} to {minutes} in STRINGS.sv['status.stale_title'] (card lines ~1793-1795); D3's owner to see why tests/card.mjs's 'drops {n}' parity arm did not refuse it.
